narrative.overview:
The agent is one more window in ZANY's world. ZANY looks like VEXcode VR, so the agent does too. It uses Open Sans, VEX-blue title bars, gold bevelled buttons, small bold uppercase labels and floating windows with coloured title bars and a soft drop shadow. A student moves between the block editor, the playground and the agent and never sees the style change. Almost every colour value is ZANY's own, under ZANY's own name.

The code is the star, so the agent rests as a narrow VEX-blue tab on the right edge of the screen. Its name runs down the tab like a book's spine, with a dot that turns green once the agent can see the student's code. A check-in slides out of the tab as a small window with ZANY's gold title bar. Opened, the chat is a blue-titled window with a light-blue tool bar, a dotted workspace for the conversation and a white composer at the foot. It sits just left of the tab with the 3D tutor standing at its left edge.

The density is a classroom tool's. Controls are 44px tall, body text is 14.5px to 15px, and the type weights run heavy (600 to 800), because the readers are 12 years old on Chromebooks.
keyCharacteristics: The visual language is borrowed whole from ZANY and VEXcode VR, never invented beside it.
Windows are white slabs with a coloured title bar, 6px corners and one soft two-layer drop shadow.
Buttons are physical, with a light top edge and a dark bottom bevel that presses in when clicked.
Labels are small, bold and uppercase, the way ZANY labels its Student ID and level picker.
The agent stays at the right edge until the student opens it.

rules.name: The ZANY Source Rule
rules.body: A new colour comes from ZANY's stylesheet under ZANY's name. Add an agent-only value only for a state ZANY has no colour for, and name it for that state.

rules.name: The Magenta Is Help Rule
rules.body: Reader Magenta appears on the Help button and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Status Dot Rule
rules.body: Wherever the agent appears at rest, a dot says whether it can see the student's code, green when it can and grey when it cannot.

rules.name: The Bold Label Rule
rules.body: A label over a field or under an icon is small, 800 weight and uppercase, the way ZANY labels "Student ID". Running sentences are never uppercase.

rules.name: The Pressed In Rule
rules.body: A pressed or open control sinks. It turns deep blue or darker gold and takes an inset shadow. It never lifts or glows.

dos: Do take every colour from ZANY's stylesheet under ZANY's name before adding one of the agent's own.
Do give every window a coloured title bar, 6px corners and the window shadow (`0 14px 34px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.3), 0 3px 8px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.2)`).
Do make the main action a gold bevelled button with 13px uppercase 800 text and a 44px height.
Do label fields with the 10.5px uppercase 800 micro label.
Do show the status dot wherever the agent is visible at rest.
Do keep primary buttons and fields 44px tall.
Do turn off the slide, the window open and every looping animation under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use any family but Open Sans outside the researcher page's monospace.
Don't use Reader Magenta for anything but Help.
Don't add a glow, a gradient fill or a lifted hover to a button. Hover brightens or washes, and press sinks.
Don't let the agent cover the student's code at rest. It waits at the edge until opened.
